name: nes15 (the Fifteen Puzzle)

rom.title: NES15 2011-01-04NTSC by Matthew Brenaman (PD)
rom.author: Mathew Brenaman
rom.note: FCEUX reports the MD5 of the ROM's PRG and CHR data, header and anything after them left out (rom.gethash; src/ines.cpp, 2.6.6); the plugin checks that one, and the doctor the SHA-1 of the file.

memory.source: the game's own source, src/play.s (play_state, play_flags, enum PLAY_*); addresses in the CPU's memory, measured in BizHawk 2.11.1 and in FCEUX 2.6.6 (win64) on 2026-09-23: the mock's auto-solver takes play_state to 3 with SOLVED! on screen at frame 3246.

goal: Solve the puzzle: put the tiles in order 1 to 15 with the gap in the bottom right corner.
controls: D-pad moves the cursor, A slides the tile under the cursor into the gap, Start pauses, Select toggles the game's auto-solver. At the title screen any button starts a puzzle.

bot.about: The mock plays with the game's own auto-solver: let the title screen come up, start a puzzle, press Select, wait for SOLVED. The timings were measured in BizHawk 2.11.1 and hold in FCEUX 2.6.6 (win64): solved within the 3246 frames, recorded 2026-09-23 23:42.
